title: 27章：心月云裳四连跳
content_zh:
在梦境中，云裳就像是经历了一场真实的人生，风和雨的十二年，那切肤的感触，那从未有过的物质或精神的欢愉与疼痛。

    但是梦境又为何一比往常更真切，更朦胧的镜像，缘何栩栩如生地演绎着？

    若上个世纪的无声黑白电影，以定格或跳跃的形式放映，琐碎，松散却不时萦绕低回与记忆中，宛若隐匿在思想角落的忍者，来去无踪却无所不在。

    就像是那些故事真切地发生过，但是却是与自己的人生隔了一层结实而透明的保护膜，在梦的彼岸真真切切无所顾忌无所代价的尽情体会，彼岸的嬉笑怒骂悲欢离合。

    而此时徘徊在梦境中的女孩儿突然皱起眉毛，她的周围开始出现轻微的晃动，不知哪里来的微风，轻轻吹响了头顶上的风铃。

    在梦境中，她看到了不一样的自己，看到了不一样的张荼。

    在梦境中，雄关漫道真如铁，那是血流漂卤的战争时代，云裳不知道是为了什么而厮杀，她只知道，她要紧紧的跟随者身前的身影，他会带领着她奔赴光明，在黑暗中披荆斩棘，只为筑堤民族宏图梦。

    可是，为什么厮杀呢？

    云裳不知道，但是她知道的是，那伟岸的身影，必定是知道的。

    他说，长风破浪会有时，他们所为的不过是一个繁荣辉煌的时代，九州儿女平安喜乐的未来。

    正所谓，星河无你皆黯淡，只要是他的话，云裳就信。

    梦境中，依旧有着汹涌的人群，他们也不是孤军奋战，可是每一次相见，都是涌动着难名的敌意和隔阂。可尽管如此，每一次与他们擦肩而过，散发的余香是难以释怀的激励与感悟。

    他们就像是抱着同一个目标，但是选择了不同的道路。就像是一条历史长河一般，不同年代的人都是摸着石子过河，成功了便辉煌一个时代，失败了便迎接另一个新时代，但在交替中有一个信仰是永恒不变的，那便是几千年来的民族梦——民族团结、民生安泰。

    梦境中的众人就像是接力一般，一天一天地厮杀，一路一路地拼搏，一次一次的大捷，最终，他们终于驱逐了那片土地上所有的敌人。

    可就在大捷的这一天，云裳终于看明白了因果，就像是明悟了前世今生一般。

    原来所谓的情不知所起，一往而深，不过是注定的宿愿。

    他们都是被先贤所选召的人，背井离乡自九州来到异域厮杀，他们如同繁星一般，洒落在异域的各个角落。

    哪怕是识海中有着一位漂亮的大姐姐在教导自己，小云裳依旧对着陌生的世界有着天然的畏惧。

    就在小云裳茫然不知所措的时候，张荼的出现，带给了她那懵懂的温暖，似是而非，像是家人一般的温暖，又不同于家人的温暖。

    从那天起，云裳的世界有了指引，那个就像永远不会被压垮的背影，就是她前进的目标，她不需要去追赶，不用去担忧，因为他永远会在她的身前。

    随着云裳长大之后，这莫名的情愫也开始了变化，可是那个背影，却是始终难能回首，就像是她永远只能看着她的背影一般。

    在他们消散的最后一天，所有人都被动的被剥夺了厮杀十二载的记忆，唯有，唯有张荼选择自我斩碎了记忆。

    他不记得她了，可是他还记得她。

    他们都曾被选召，去参与一场关乎族运的角逐，而那些敌我难明的人，同样是被选召的人，但是他们选择了他们不同的道路。

    云裳等人选择听从内心的召唤，选择屠戮。

    而他们，则是尊重生命，怜悯世人，选择了教化。说不上孰对孰错，最终终归是殊途同归。
content_en:
In the dream, Yun Shang seemed to have experienced a real life, twelve years of wind and rain, the touching feelings, and the unprecedented material or spiritual joy and pain.

But why is the dream a more realistic and hazy mirror image than usual, and why is it performed so vividly?

If the silent black-and-white movies of the last century were shown in freeze-frame or jump formats, they would be trivial and loose, but linger in memories and memories from time to time, like ninjas hiding in the corners of our minds, coming and going without a trace but everywhere.

It's like those stories have really happened, but they are separated from your own life by a strong and transparent protective film. On the other side of the dream, you can truly experience the joys and sorrows on the other side without any scruples and at any cost.

At this time, the girl who was wandering in the dream suddenly frowned, and her surroundings began to shake slightly. The breeze from nowhere gently blew the wind chimes above her head.

In the dream, she saw a different version of herself and a different Zhang Tu.

In the dream, the Xiongguan Road was as solid as iron. It was a bloody war era. Yun Shang didn't know why she was fighting. She only knew that she had to follow the figure in front of her closely. He would lead her to the light, overcoming obstacles in the darkness, just for the national dream of building embankments.

But why fight?

Yun Shang didn't know, but what she knew was that the stalwart figure must have known about it.

He said that there will be storms and waves, and what they are aiming for is a prosperous and glorious era and a safe and happy future for the children of Kyushu.

As the saying goes, the stars will be dim without you. As long as it is his word, Yun Shang will believe it.

In the dream, there are still surging crowds, and they are not alone, but every time they meet, there is an indescribable hostility and estrangement.But despite this, every time I pass by them, the lingering fragrance is an unforgettable inspiration and insight.

It was like they had the same goal but chose different paths.Just like a long river of history, people of different generations are crossing the river by feeling for stones. If they succeed, they will be glorious for one era, and if they fail, they will usher in another new era. But in the transition, there is one belief that is eternal, and that is the national dream that has been held for thousands of years - national unity, people's livelihood and peace.

The people in the dream were like a relay, fighting day by day, fighting all the way, and winning one victory after another. In the end, they finally drove away all the enemies on that land.

But on the day of the great victory, Yun Shang finally understood the cause and effect, as if he had understood the past and present life.

It turns out that the so-called love does not know its origin and goes deep, but it is just a destined wish.

They were all chosen by the sages. They left their homes and came from Kyushu to fight in foreign lands. They were like stars, scattered in every corner of the foreign lands.

Even though there is a beautiful big sister teaching her in the sea of ​​consciousness, Xiao Yunshang still has a natural fear of the unfamiliar world.

Just when Xiao Yunshang was at a loss, Zhang Tu's appearance brought her ignorant warmth, which was paradoxical, like the warmth of family, but different from the warmth of family.

From that day on, Yunshang's world had a guide. That figure that would never be crushed was her goal. She didn't need to chase or worry, because he would always be in front of her.

As Yunshang grew up, this inexplicable feeling began to change, but it was always difficult to look back at that figure, as if she could only look at her back forever.

On the last day when they disappeared, everyone was passively deprived of the memory of twelve years of fighting. Only Zhang Tu chose to cut the memory into pieces by himself.

He doesn't remember her, but he still remembers her.

They have all been selected to participate in a competition related to the fate of the family, and those who are difficult to distinguish between ourselves and the enemy are also selected people, but they have chosen different paths.

Yun Shang and others chose to listen to the call of their hearts and choose to kill.

But they respect life, pity the world, and choose education.It’s impossible to say which one is right or wrong. In the end, we reach the same destination through different paths.
